4.9

Our Commitment to Open-Source and the Community

"Everyone knows the industrial landscape must digitize quickly to stay competitive. Yet industrial software is still handled like it was 30 years ago—hidden behind proprietary models, opaque pricing, and siloed knowledge. We believe the best way to create the best product is to get it into as many hands as possible, as quickly as possible. That’s why we’re fully committed to Open-Source and the community around it.

Our goal is to provide an ideal environment for daring teams in small, medium, and large enterprises to just get started—no strings attached. That’s why our software core is and will remain under an open-source license, our management console will always include a community tier, and we’ll make our knowledge openly available. No gatekeeping whatsoever.
‍
Let’s change how software is handled in the industry—one deployment at a time."
‍
— Alex and Jeremy
